title: Vector-to-Pin UX and Refusal States
negative_results: a single candidate without calibration falls to REGION, never a forced UNIQUE_POINT, with a why-unavailable message naming the missing calibration
a missing CRS or epoch yields a REFUSAL state (invariant 9)
an empty candidate set yields a REFUSAL state (NO_UNIQUE_GEOGRAPHIC_DECODE, a normal successful result)
a negative candidate count is refused

claims.statement: The vector-to-pin state machine selects UNIQUE_POINT / ALIAS_SET / REGION / HEATMAP / REFUSAL from the decode result and calibration availability; each state is reachable and the boundary between ALIAS_SET and HEATMAP is tested (POWER).
A single pin is produced only with a prospective calibration and a declared CRS and epoch; otherwise the UX returns a region, alias set, heatmap, or refusal, never a forced pin.

privacy_check: CLEAN - no inputs, synthetic CRS/epoch literals only, no private data
